commands.help: Obtain Microsoft Entra tokens through a browser authorization code flow
commands.long_help: Runs in the interactive Windows user's desktop. The user must already have a valid Entra browser session; the client ID must have tenant consent and allow the nativeclient redirect URI. Browser: 0 for Microsoft Edge, 1 for Google Chrome. The BOF watches window titles for up to 15 seconds and reports tokens to the operator. Requires a Sliver client, server, and implant with built-in Reflektor BOF support.

arguments.name: browser
arguments.desc: Browser selector: 0 for Edge, 1 for Chrome
